claims.statement: The central finite-difference Fourier multiplier equals i sin(kh)/h, with removable value ik at h=0.
The four-spinor central-difference Dirac symbol differs from the continuum symbol by O(h^2) on every fixed momentum mode.
The continuum and lattice symbols obey exact Clifford mass-shell square identities.
Each integer torus mode has O(h^2) generator error and converges.
Each fixed finite Fourier packet has pointwise O(h^2) generator error and pointwise convergence.

boundaries: No full L2 operator convergence theorem.
No self-adjointness or strong resolvent convergence theorem.
Finite Fourier packet convergence is pointwise with fixed finite support.
No interacting or gauge-covariant continuum generator theorem.
